airport: Jaipur International Airport (JAI), Sanganer (~12 km from city center)
localTransit: Jaipur Metro (Pink Line connecting Mansarovar to Badi Chaupar), auto-rickshaws, pre-paid taxis, and app-based cabs (Uber, Ola)
intercityBus: Sindhi Camp Central Bus Stand (RSRTC state buses and private deluxe coaches)
notes: Verify live train and bus schedules via official IRCTC / RSRTC portals before departure.

airport: Dabolim Airport (GOI) in South Goa and Manohar International Airport, Mopa (GOX) in North Goa
railway: Madgaon Junction (MAO), Thivim (THVM), Vasco da Gama (VSG), Karmali (KRMI)
localTransit: Self-drive scooter/car rentals, pilot motorcycle taxis, GoaMiles app-based cabs, and Kadamba state transport buses
intercityBus: Panaji KTC Bus Stand, Mapusa KTC Bus Stand, and Margao KTC Bus Stand
notes: Always carry a valid driving license for rental vehicles. Verify ferry crossings for river transit.

airport: Kullu-Manali Airport, Bhuntar (KUU), approximately 50 km south of Manali
railway: Nearest broad-gauge railhead is Chandigarh Railway Station (CDG, ~310 km) or Ambala Cantt
localTransit: Local taxis (Himachal Pradesh Tourism Development Corporation / Manali Taxi Union), auto-rickshaws, and private rental motorbikes
intercityBus: Himachal Road Transport Corporation (HRTC) Volvos and private overnight sleeper buses from Delhi and Chandigarh
notes: Rohtang Pass permits must be obtained online in advance. Highway conditions vary during winter snowfall and monsoon; check live HRTC advisories.

airport: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (BOM), Terminal 1 (Domestic) & Terminal 2 (International/Domestic)
railway: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), Mumbai Central (MMCT), Bandra Terminus (BDTS), Lokmanya Tilak Terminus (LTT), Dadar (DR)
localTransit: Mumbai Suburban Railway (Western, Central, Harbour lines), Mumbai Metro, BEST public buses, metered black-and-yellow taxis, and autorickshaws (suburbs only)
intercityBus: MSRTC State transport bus terminals and private bus hubs at Dadar, Borivali, and Vashi
notes: Peak rush hours on suburban local trains are 08:30-11:30 and 17:30-20:30 on weekdays. Verify coastal road and sealink access timings.

airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL), Terminals 1, 2, and 3
railway: New Delhi Railway Station (NDLS), Old Delhi (DLI), Hazrat Nizamuddin (NZM), Anand Vihar Terminal (ANVT), Delhi Sarai Rohilla (DEE)
localTransit: Delhi Metro (extensive network with Airport Express Line), DTC electric/CNG buses, metered auto-rickshaws, and ride-hailing cabs
intercityBus: Inter-State Bus Terminals (ISBT) at Kashmere Gate, Anand Vihar, and Sarai Kale Khan
notes: The Delhi Metro Smart Card or digital QR tickets via DMRC app offer seamless travel across the capital region.

airport: Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport, Babatpur (VNS, ~26 km northwest of the city)
railway: Varanasi Junction (BSB), Banaras (BSBS / formerly Manduadih), Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Junction (DDU, ~18 km away)
localTransit: Hand-rowed and motor boats along the Ganga Ghats, cycle-rickshaws, e-rickshaws, auto-rickshaws, and app cabs
intercityBus: UPSRTC Bus Stand near Varanasi Junction Railway Station
notes: Old city alleyways (galis) leading to the Ghats are pedestrian-only; vehicles cannot enter.

airport: Maharana Pratap Airport, Dabok (UDR, ~22 km east of the city)
railway: Udaipur City Railway Station (UDZ), Rana Pratap Nagar (RPZ)
localTransit: Auto-rickshaws, pre-paid tourist cabs, e-rickshaws, and foot travel around Lake Pichola and the Old City
intercityBus: Udaipur Central Bus Depot (RSRTC buses to Jaipur, Ahmedabad, Jodhpur, and Mount Abu)
notes: Streets around Old City and Jagdish Temple are narrow; auto-rickshaws or walking are preferable to large cabs.

airport: Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport, Leh (IXL) - one of the highest commercial airports in the world
railway: No direct railway; nearest railheads are Jammu Tawi (JAT, ~700 km) and Chandigarh (~670 km)
localTransit: Ladakh Taxi Union pre-paid registered cabs, rental Royal Enfield motorbikes, and local mini-buses
intercityBus: HRTC and JKRTC bus services via Manali-Leh Highway and Srinagar-Leh Highway (seasonal, typically June to October)
notes: Mandatory 48-hour acclimatization rest upon flying into Leh. Inner Line Permits (ILP) required for Nubra Valley, Pangong Tso, and Tso Moriri.

airport: Cochin International Airport (COK), Nedumbassery (~28 km northeast of Ernakulam)
railway: Ernakulam Junction (ERS / South) and Ernakulam Town (ERN / North)
localTransit: Kochi Metro (Aluva to Thripunithura), Kochi Water Metro (battery-electric passenger ferries connecting islands), auto-rickshaws, and KSRTC city buses
intercityBus: KSRTC Central Bus Station, Ernakulam (adjacent to Ernakulam South Railway Station)
notes: The Kochi Water Metro connects Fort Kochi, Vypin, High Court, and Kakkanad with integrated single-token ticketing.

airport: Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport (ATQ, ~11 km northwest of the city)
localTransit: Free Golden Temple shuttle buses from railway station, auto-rickshaws, e-rickshaws, and tourist cabs to Wagah Border
intercityBus: Amritsar Integrated Bus Stand (PRTC and private buses to Delhi, Chandigarh, and Jammu)
notes: Special shared cabs and coaches run daily from Amritsar to the Attari-Wagah Border Beating Retreat ceremony starting around 15:00.
